name: savvy-progress
description: Session row above the prompt in every session (model, cost, tokens, context, 5-hour and 7-day limits, time) and a session panel (Details or /agents-info): cost split, usage limits, context by category, tokens by kind, cost by model, plus running, finished and planned subagents and the /savvy-flow progress bar. sgs-kit fork of johnnyvizz's savvy-progress.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale (en, ru, tr)

exploreModel.title: Explore subagent model
exploreModel.description: Model for an Explore subagent when the Agent call names none. inherit: the main session's model; opus: Opus whatever the main session runs on

generalModel.title: General-purpose subagent model
generalModel.description: Model for a general-purpose subagent (also an Agent call without a type) when the call names none. inherit: the main session's model; opus: Opus whatever the main session runs on
